extra.reason: Onboarding flow implemented: 3-page SwiftUI TabView with welcome, language selection, and completion screens
Authentication implemented: sign in, sign up, forgot password, change password, token refresh, sign out, account view with balance/subscription display
Core chat system implemented: create/select/delete chats, send messages with SSE streaming, edit/delete/regenerate messages, title generation, memory loop handling, draft persistence
Settings view implemented: model selection, communication style, language, assistant name, behavior toggles, persona (1000 char limit), custom system prompt
Donate view implemented: displays donation options from global config with copy-to-clipboard and external links
